scope: Isolated real movement/mouse/E/Enter with one explicit Unity OnApplicationFocus false/true notification fixture. Verifies callback/input boundary, NOT operating-system focus transitions or human feel.
checks: focus-loss notification pauses the session and clears physical focus
E during lost focus cannot open the document
real Enter resumes but E held across focus gain cannot dispatch
released key permits the same visible document to regain focus
fresh E after focus recovery opens the actual selected document
